details: Open/close and hold doors. Guide people to their seats. Help the elderly and children.
Study and deliver assigned lesson to children ages 5 to 7.
Assist console/camera operators as needed. Arrive at least one hour early for briefing.
Guide attendees as they arrive to park in an appropiate spot in a timely manner so as to not obstruct any emergency exits. Guide attendees as the exit church campus. Arrive 30mins early for briefing.
Assist staff getting the auditorium ready for service. Assist staff leaving the auditorium neatly organized after service.
Greet and answer questions as visitors come to the booth. Make sure first time visitors get a book/mug or other gift.
